# BONIRA — Production Deployment Specification

## Status
`SPECIFICATION STRUCTURE COMPLETE`
`UNSPECIFIED PRODUCTION TOPOLOGY — DO NOT INVENT / DO NOT CERTIFY`

Governed by `PD-004`.

- Production and non-production boundaries must be explicit.
- Exact host count, cloud provider, Kubernetes/container platform, HA topology, replica count and failover architecture are UNSPECIFIED.
- Database, application, static/media, proxy/load-balancer and background-worker components are deployed only where the actual approved runtime requires them.
- TLS and environment-scoped secrets handling are mandatory; exact product/provider is not specified.
- Migrations require versioned sequencing, pre-check, rollback/roll-forward decision and evidence.
- Production release must retain version, migration/config change, activation authority and deployment evidence.
- Backup/recovery integrates with `BONIRA_RECOVERY_POLICY_MATRIX`.
- Monitoring/logging must support incident, security and audit traceability; tooling/thresholds are not invented.
- Tenant isolation/object scope are invariant.
- Support/emergency access follows the Operating Specification.

`CONDITIONALLY READY FOR BACKLOG`
`IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZATION: NOT YET GRANTED`

BONIRA_OPERATING_SPECIFICATION.md.text:
# BONIRA — Approved Operating Specification

Governed by `PD-005`.

| Responsibility | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Release Owner | Designated accountable responsibility per production release; exact assignee not invented |
| Incident Owner | Designated accountable responsibility per incident |
| Production Activation Authority | Explicitly designated; technical superuser status alone is insufficient |
| Escalation Responsibility | Explicit path required; no timer/severity/SLA invented |
| Emergency / Support Access Authority | Explicit, scoped, auditable and revocable |
| Rollback / Roll-forward Responsibility | Recorded in release/incident evidence |
| Access Revocation Responsibility | Explicit owner for expiry/revoke |

Release evidence includes version/change/migration/activation/rollback-or-roll-forward evidence.
Incident evidence includes identity/timestamps/owner/log evidence/actions/access grants/resolution evidence.

`ON-CALL POLICY ≠ AUTOMATIC 24×7 STAFFED ROTATION`

No SLA, SLO, response time, severity scheme or staffed rotation is invented.

`PRODUCTION-OPERATIONS-READINESS: NOT YET PROVEN`
`HUMAN SIGN-OFF: NOT EXECUTED`
`IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZATION: NOT YET GRANTED`

# BONIRA — Payroll Statutory Source Package Specification

Governed by `PD-031`.

Every activated statutory package must be versioned/effective-dated and tied to official Tax/Labor/Social Security authority, component classification, taxable/insurable bases, caps/exemptions/shares, YTD treatment, rounding, retroactivity, schema version, review/approval and evidence.

No current Iranian rate/cap/threshold/value is supplied here.

`NO OFFICIAL STATUTORY EVIDENCE → DO NOT INVENT CURRENT VALUE`

Current statutory values/evidence remain UTV.
